paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between Fleiss Kappa and two measures of ambiguity. The horizontal axis represents the values of "Ambiguity Std" in the left chart and "Max Ambiguity" in the right chart, ranging from 0.00 to 0.94 in increments of 0.47 and 0.94 respectively. The vertical axis, labeled "Fleiss Kappa", displays values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The left chart presents four bars, all colored blue, corresponding to Ambiguity Std values of 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, with Fleiss Kappa values of approximately 0.88, 0.46, 0.24, and 0.03, respectively. This chart depicts a decreasing trend in Fleiss Kappa as Ambiguity Std increases. The right chart similarly contains four blue bars corresponding to Max Ambiguity values of 1, 2, 3, and a value label of 0.94, along with Fleiss Kappa values of approximately 0.89, 0.8, 0.23, and 0.03, respectively. The bars in each chart are not sorted and none are visually emphasized.
